claim: random_forest is the strongest single model (0.8287 CV)
note: Measured on 3 identical passes; deterministic given the frozen data and fixed seed.

claim: Soft-vote ensemble does NOT beat the best single model
note: 0.8273 vs 0.8287. Well inside the +/-0.015-0.030 fold spread, so 'tied' is the honest reading, not 'worse'.

claim: knn is clearly the weakest model (0.7879) and is a poor ensemble member
logistic leaves 9 hyperparameters at their defaults; only C is tuned
note: make introspect --show-untuned lists them. Widening this search is the cheapest untried lever.

claim: hist_gradient_boosting leaves 16 parameters at defaults; only 2 are tuned
note: Largest untuned surface of any model here.

claim: No model has been tried with engineered features beyond the 12 current ones
note: explore proposed Title, Deck, FamilySize, IsAlone, AgeMissing; all are in use. Nothing newer has been proposed.

claim: select_members crossed experiment boundaries, contaminating the val score
note: It filtered on frozen_sha256 but not experiment_id, so exp-002 ensembled members tuned by the pre-container baseline on all 712 rows -- including exp-002's own 143 validation rows. Its 0.8392 was a selection statistic, not a measurement. Fixed by scoping select_members to the open experiment; exp-002 abandoned because its val split is spent and re-reading it would be the same error again.

claim: Ensemble members must be scoped to the current experiment, not just the frozen dataset
note: Two experiments share a frozen_sha256 by construction, so that filter alone never separates them.

claim: Validation 0.8462 vs CV 0.8190 on 143 rows -- the gap is within noise, not evidence of improvement
note: 143 rows carries roughly +/-4%. A 0.027 gap is well inside that; reading it as a real gain would be exactly the mistake these splits exist to prevent.

claim: Training on 569 rows instead of 712 costs roughly 0.006-0.010 CV
note: Best single fell 0.8287 (712 rows, exp-001) -> 0.8225 (569 rows, exp-002/3). That is the price of a per-experiment val split, and it is worth paying.
